profile_text.body:
Ouster, Inc. describes itself as a provider of digital lidar sensors for automation, drones, and robotics. Its website says the sensors are intended to transform autonomy in vehicles, robotics, and smart cities. The site quotes Matt Reiland, Technical Director, Automation Innovation at Komatsu, saying that Ouster products developed through the partnership can withstand shock, vibration, and temperature constraints while delivering enhanced range and spatial awareness for harsh mining environments.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, trading under the ticker OUST, with SEC CIK number 0001816581. It also appears under the name OUSTER INC. The company is associated with 281 California legal exposure records; no individual cases are listed.
